description: This is the main source file for the 'swabble' command-line interface, defining the CLI entry point, dispatch logic for subcommands, and specific handlers for various command groups such as 'swabble', 'mic', and 'service'. It coordinates the execution flow based on user commands and invokes respective command classes.

methods.name: runCLI
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the command-line interface, resolves the invocation, and manages the overall control flow, returning an exit code.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches the first command argument to the appropriate subcommand handler; handles errors and defaults to 'swabble'.

methods.name: dispatchSwabble
methods.description: Routes subcommands under 'swabble' to specific handlers like 'mic', 'service', or custom handlers based on the subcommand string.

methods.name: swabbleHandlers
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping 'swabble' subcommands to their corresponding asynchronous handler closures.

methods.name: dispatchMic
methods.description: Handles subcommands related to 'mic', such as 'list' and 'set', by invoking respective command classes.

methods.name: dispatchService
methods.description: Handles subcommands related to 'service', such as 'install', 'uninstall', and 'status', by invoking respective command classes.

methods.name: subcommand
methods.description: Extracts a specific subcommand string from the command-line argument path at the given index; throws an error if missing.
